specification.title: No retrieval result persists an empty, honest result
specification.description: No retrieval result: a source filter matching nothing produces a persisted zero-claim/zero-citation result with zero LLM invocations.
specification.purpose: Verify a source filter matching nothing persists a zero-claim, zero-citation ResearchResult with zero LLM invocations.
specification.operational_relevance: Empty results must be explicit so investigation flows do not mistake the absence of retrieval for a non-response.
specification.regression_risk: The executor could invoke the model or fabricate claims when retrieval returned nothing.
